verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Epic serves llms.txt on both www.unrealengine.com and dev.epicgames.com, so an agent can be pointed at it. However, the same probe shows the CDN intermittently returns HTTP 403 challenges to non-browser clients, and appending .md to docs URLs returns an HTML SPA shell rather than markdown. Some reference docs, such as the Python API reference, are fetchable as plain HTML. Missing for 10: reliable agent access to llms.txt without a browser-grade client, markdown or agent-oriented doc variants, first-party documentation describing the llms.txt surface, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Epic now serves llms.txt on BOTH www.unrealengine.com ('# Unreal Engine — Epic Games' real-time 3D creation tool...') and dev.epicgames.com ('# Epic Developer Community'), verified live.
the Python editor-scripting docs, Remote Control API references, and UAT/automation CLI docs on dev.epicgames.com/documentation ARE fetchable keylessly.
